comments.body_html: Hey is this mod for a begineer coder like me who want to make custom valuable items?

comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
Yes, I’ve put together some common item settings. Just follow the Wiki tutorial, and you can quickly create new items that work with this mod. You can even share the Wiki with AI tools like ChatGPT, Deepseek, or Claude Code to help you out.

If an item fails to load, the logs will tell you why. Need AI to check the logs? Just delete them once, restart the server to generate fresh ones, and share those. This helps avoid hitting AI’s context limits.

Plus, this mod lets your items go into any container - even if the original item had container restrictions.

comments.author: MaskofHumble
comments.body_html: Can I use this to make a infinite injector that slowly heals me and cures all negative effects? xD

comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
Sure, just set the MaxHpResource of the medicine high enough, and register a BuffsInfo with a duration longer than the match length (you can directly set it to one day: { “Duration”: 86400 }` ). This can be used for gradual healing.

To treat negative effects, you just need to set EffectsDamage and configure the duration.
